title: Amwill Health Care Gets CDSCO Nod to Import, Sell FoliColor Hair Products in India
summary: Bengaluru: Amwill Health Care Limited has received a new import registration certificate from the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) for importing FoliColor-Oxidative hair colour...

contentHtml:
Bengaluru: Amwill Health Care Limited has received a new import registration certificate from the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) for importing FoliColor-Oxidative hair colour products into India, with the approval allowing the company to commence import and commercial sale of the product in the country.

The company received the licence on October 9, 2026. The approval relates to the import of cosmetics into India and has been issued under Registration Certificate No. RC/COS-007631.

The approved product is identified as FoliColor - Hair Color, with Black specified as the variant. The registration certificate is valid from October 8, 2026, to October 7, 2031, unless it is suspended or cancelled earlier under the applicable rules.

According to the company, the new approval will enable Amwill Health Care to commence the import and commercial sale of FoliColor-Oxidative hair colour products in India. The company has stated that the approval is expected to expand its product portfolio and revenue.

The regulatory authority granting the approval is the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO). The licence represents a new grant, rather than a renewal or amendment of an existing approval.

The company has also stated that there has been no withdrawal, cancellation or suspension of the licence or approval. Consequently, no related impact or penalty arising from such action is applicable.

The supplier or counterparty associated with the approval has been identified as not being a related party to Amwill Health Care Limited. The company also stated that any subsequent reporting requirement concerning the actual impact and corrective action following withdrawal, cancellation or suspension of the key approval is not applicable in the present case.

Amwill Health Care Limited, with its registered office in Chamrajpet, Bengaluru, is the listed entity that received the regulatory approval.
